escalation_note: 900 dpi --value crops proving the measured row grids at both ends of each schedule: p2 bands 1 and 13 (reproduce 200.00 and 1,000.00) and p3 bands 1 and 20 (reproduce 7.88 and 4,697.40). One extra crop was needed on p3 because its header block is two printed bands deep (the two-line column header plus a blank band the form prints under it), which shifts every data row by one band - the crop settled that index. All figures are machine-typed; nothing was bistable.

2.measure_note: A NATIVELY LANDSCAPE page (poppler renders it 2156x1687), so rows advance top-to-bottom and axis='y'. Column bands are the page's own vertical rules: 6.03/13.50/40.93/79.17/88.87 = Date | Name of Contributor | Address | Amount. Row bands are its horizontal rules on a constant ~2.72 pct pitch; [16.33,19.06] is the printed single-line column-header row (this sheet prints NO blank banner strip under it, unlike its own Form B on p3) so band 1 is the first data row, and the bands after [51.72,54.45] are the empty printed rows the filer left unused before the grand total. PROVED with 900 dpi --value crops of bands 1 and 13 against the Amount column, reproducing 200.00 and 1,000.00.

3.measure_note: Same natively-landscape geometry, axis='y'. Column bands from a relaxed vertical projection (the default 0.70 coverage returns only two rules on this text-dense sheet; at 0.40 it returns 6.15/14.73/38.08/49.40/78.94/87.66 = table edge | Date of Expenditure | Person or Organization | City | Purpose of Expenditure | Amount | right edge). Row bands were taken by projecting horizontal rules ONLY over the x-window 79.5-87.5% - inside the Amount column, where no text can register as a rule - which returns a clean ~2.72 pct pitch that the text-dense full-page projection does not. Bands excluded as non-data: [16.93,24.79] the TWO-LINE printed column-header row and [24.79,27.48] the blank banner band the form prints beneath it - together they are why every data row on this sheet sits one band lower than on p2. PROVED with 900 dpi --value crops of bands 1 and 20 against the Amount column, reproducing 7.88 and 4,697.40.

notes: James Ebert's SECOND 2026 filing in this chunk - the June 16 Primary Election report, following his May 26 pre-primary report (key c2dfd036), whose 74,996.71 / 55,909.71 cumulative figures are exactly this filing's Last Report column, so the two chain cleanly. The 2026 county form, typed, three pages: p1 cover (signed 6-15-2026, though index.csv carries a blank filing date), FORM A on p2 and FORM B on p3, both NATIVELY LANDSCAPE (axis 'y'). A layout difference WITHIN one document worth recording: Form A prints a single-line column header and no banner strip, while Form B prints a two-line header PLUS a blank banner band, so the two sheets' data rows start at different band indices - page-to-page grid habits are not constant even inside a single filing. IN-KIND items appear on BOTH schedules by design (Bell Printing 200.00 and Gibson Green Acres Dairy 3,000.00 each appear once as a contribution and once as an expenditure); both sides reconcile to the cent WITH them included, so they are not double counts to be netted out. On this filing the county redacted ONLY the street portion of each address: the candidate's own City/Zip (Farr West 84404) and every donor's city/state/zip print in full, so donor_city/donor_state are complete here. SCANNED, not a Polimorphic e-filing: no text layer over any page and no Polimorphic footer.
